hooks.prompt: A Bash command is about to run. Read the command from tool_input.command in $ARGUMENTS. GATE: if the command does NOT contain `git push`, output exactly {} and stop immediately — do nothing else, do not call any tools. If it IS a git push: run the Decibel guardian security scan with action report for the current project (omit project_id so it resolves from the working directory). Try the tool named mcp__plugin_tools_decibel-tools__guardian first; if it is unavailable, try mcp__decibel-tools__guardian. FAIL-OPEN: if the guardian tool is unavailable, denied, or errors for any reason, output exactly {} (do NOT block the push). Only if the scan completes successfully AND its overall grade is D or F, output JSON: {"continue": false, "stopReason": "Guardian grade D/F. Fix these before pushing: [list the findings]"}. In every other case output exactly {}.
